# Company brain

## brain/facts/project.md
# Project facts — Agent KBase

## Mission

Open-source **agent knowledge base**: curated business truth in git (`brain/`), plus CLI, web wizard, read-only MCP, and remote MCP (Streamable HTTP on the web app). Optional Engram for decisions across chats.

**Commercial layer (separate from open core):** done-for-you setup, draft review, publish workflow with human approval — quoted after a start call. Auto-publish connectors (WhatsApp, blog, LinkedIn Act) are waitlist / not shipped in OSS.

## ICP

Self-employed or small company with a **public website** and **no marketing team** (shop, studio, consultancy).

## Ground truth

* **Draft rule:** A price, client, ranking, or result not in facts is cut or marked `[CONFIRM]`; nothing goes live without human yes.
* **Service flow (described, not fully automated in v1):** draft → human approve or stop → article on site only after yes → LinkedIn only after article is live.
* **Five pre-publish checks** on https://agentkbase.com/company-brain (title, prices in notes, provable claims, traceability, safe CTA).
* **Not similarity RAG:** the product does not answer from “close enough” text; claims must be in the folder or `[CONFIRM]`.

## Do not invent

Anything not listed here or in sibling fact files must be confirmed with the project owner.

## brain/facts/offer-limits.md
# Offer limits (what we do not promise)

## Public commitments we refuse in copy

* Guaranteed Google rankings, traffic, or “#1 in AI answers” (GEO).
* New client volume or hours saved as a deliverable.
* Auto-publish without human approval on the OSS path.
* A hosted-only brain with no export to files you own (we offer both: hosted session + `brain.zip` / git).

## Positioning wedge

We govern **what a small business may publish as true** (site → brain → eval → human yes), not full company ops (CRM, Slack ingestion, 24/7 workers). Competitors such as GuruSup target scaleups with connectors and workers; we target marketing truth for owners with a website.

## Indexing stance (Phase 1)

* Facts live in `brain/facts/` with stable headings.
* Learn guides are **reference** under `brain/stories/learn/` (synced); agents distill into facts before treating as ground truth.
* Future claim index is **derived** from approved markdown — index does not approve new facts.

## brain/open-questions.md
# Open questions

The agent must **not** guess answers here. Ask the human or mark `[CONFIRM]` in drafts.

* [CONFIRM] **Service fee or range** for setup, start call, and written agreement (site: quoted only).
* [CONFIRM] **Pilot scope:** revision rounds, channels (email vs WhatsApp), who clicks publish.
* [CONFIRM] **SLA** for draft review in the mounted company-brain circuit if promised publicly.
* [CONFIRM] First buyer priority: dev who installs vs owner who pays setup.
* [CONFIRM] `@agentkbase/mcp` npm publish version aligned with CLI 0.1.2 (AK-8).
* [CONFIRM] Remote MCP OAuth / Claude directory submit date.
* [CONFIRM] **`MCP_API_KEY` in production:** who mints and rotates the bearer for agentkbase.com (Vercel env); clients get it out-of-band until OAuth ships.
* [CONFIRM] **Remote `/mcp` rate limits (H-11c):** Vercel Firewall vs edge middleware vs per-key quota — not implemented in `route.ts`.

## brain/stories/positioning.md
# Positioning (public-safe)

## Problem

Buyers confuse “company brain + 24/7 workers” (hosted, many connectors) with “folder of what you may say on your site.”

## How the offer works

Agent KBase fills `brain/` from a public URL (wizard or CLI), human crosses out inventions, `brain eval` catches draft prices/claims, human approves before live marketing. Optional done-for-you loop on company-brain.

## Wedge sentence

We do not sync the whole company — we make sure what you publish about **what you sell** matches what is true, with sources and your yes. **Your brain is files you own;** hosted Claude profile is optional entry, not the only store.

## Owner-facing surface (minimal)

One Instinct-style paragraph on the home page: company assistant on **Telegram** first (WhatsApp later), no new interfaces, concrete jobs (LinkedIn draft, stop a price you do not charge, wait for your yes). MCP and git stay under **For developers**. Project copy spec: store `docs/positioning-minimal-whatsapp.md`.

## How we know it works

Public page: https://agentkbase.com/learn/12-what-you-sell  
Remote MCP learn: https://agentkbase.com/learn/14-claude-mcp
